title: Miso Shiitake Temaki
description: Hand rolls with miso-glazed shiitake, crisp lettuce and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Sauté sliced shiitake until browned and most moisture has evaporated.
Mix white miso, mirin and honey; add to mushrooms and cook briefly until thick and glossy. Turn off heat, add sesame oil and cool slightly.
Cut each nori sheet in half, then set a small bed of rice diagonally on each half.
Add dry lettuce, cucumber and miso shiitake, roll into cones and serve immediately.
notes: Use restrained amounts of miso so the mushrooms, rather than salt, are the main flavor.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
